|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Cancel Stunning Leader. OR If you occupy a site, 'find' any one of your missing characters there. OR ▲ Lost In The Wilderness or a Rogue speeder. OR Cancel opponent's attempt to randomly remove one or more cards from your hand (except with Monnok).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Nice Of You Guys To Drop By (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Take Lost In The Wilderness or a Rogue speeder into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If you occupy a site, find one of your missing characters there. OR Cancel Stunning Leader. OR Cancel opponent’s attempt to randomly remove one or more cards from your hand (except with Monnok).” '''What changed:''' “Cancel Stunning Leader.” → “Take Lost In The Wilderness or a Rogue speeder into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; “'find' any” → “find”; “▲ Lost In The Wilderness or a Rogue speeder.” → “Cancel Stunning Leader.”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 13*. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Nice Of You Guys To Drop By]].
* Later text: [[Nice Of You Guys To Drop By (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Nice Of You Guys To Drop By (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Nice Of You Guys To Drop By]].
